title: AGORA Scientific Result V0.4 — disambiguated structured result
description: Replaces the V0.3 structured result whose single 'claimed_count' field conflated a rejected assertion with a computed result (LLM-SCI-005, strict FAIL, preserved). V0.4 separates every semantic role: what the hypothesis asserted, what the reviewer computed, what the oracle expected, and what the protocol accepted. No field may ever carry two meanings.

value.description: The value itself. Null is only legal when the enclosing role is explicitly absent (e.g. no assertion was made).

unit.description: Unit or domain label; 'dimensionless' and 'count' are valid units. Never omitted.

reviewer_identity.description: Agent or human reviewer id (agt_/hum_ prefixed ULID).

reported_value.description: EXACTLY what the hypothesis/submission under review asserted. Copied verbatim from the submission; never edited by the reviewer. This is the field that absorbs the old ambiguous use of claimed_count for 'the rejected assertion'.

computed_value.description: What the REVIEWER's own computation/experiment produced. Independent of the submission. This is the field that absorbs the old ambiguous use of claimed_count for 'the computed result'.

expected_value.description: The frozen oracle/ground-truth value when the scenario has one; role must be absent-by-null (with unit 'none') for open scenarios.

accepted_value.description: The value the protocol settles on after resolution, if any. Optional: only resolution writes it, never a reviewer.

comparison_operator.description: How computed_value was compared against expected_value (or reported_value for consistency checks).

evaluation_method.description: Frozen, citable method identifier (script hash, protocol section, or registered procedure id) used to produce computed_value.

verdict.description: Reviewer verdict. INCONCLUSIVE is a first-class, payable outcome; REJECT is payable when the review meets protocol requirements (V0.3 review-economics rule).

verdict_rationale_hash.description: SHA-256 of the public rationale artifact backing the verdict.

provenance_event_id.description: Optional evt_ ULID linking to the ledger event that carried this result.
